headline: Mondelez International (MDLZ) Backs Final Boss Sour To Grow Its Retail Footprint
summary: Mondelez International's venture fund invested in Final Boss Sour's funding round to support the brand's retail expansion. The deal centers on growing Final Boss Sour's presence in stores and broadening its reach in the snack aisle. This move reflects ongoing activity by NasdaqGS:MDLZ in backing emerging snack brands through its corporate venture arm. For investors watching Mondelez International, the move highlights how a large snack company is engaging with smaller, fast developing brands...

headline: Is Mondelez International (MDLZ) Reasonable on Cash Flow or Rich on Earnings?
summary: Mondelez International has gained 12.8% year to date, yet its valuation checks are pulling in different directions, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to meaningful upside while earnings multiples make the stock look expensive. The 12.8% year to date return suggests investors have been willing to pay more for Mondelez International stock so far this year, even as longer term returns have been weaker.
